classifier.name: verified-generated/2
classifier.rule: exclude an item from numerator and denominator only when its path, its blob and its generator's blob at that commit all equal a verified entry; every other generation claim (headers, BEGIN/END blocks) is counted as handwritten

enforcement_exclusions.docs/audits: H548: measured but outside proposed enforcement until r1

cases.zero_denominator: d_anchor == 0: no ratio is invented, r = 0, m = max lookback numerator
cases.zero_numerator: n_anchor == 0, d_anchor > 0: r = 0, m from lookback

policy.fallback: an area outside the policy (first seen after the evaluation window, or with no anchor) gets r = 0, m = 0 for every metric: only n = 0 passes; it never trains its own allowance
policy.formula: pass iff n <= r*d + m, tested as n*b*e <= a*d*e + c*b for r = a/b, m = c/e
policy.margin: m = max(0, max over the area anchor's lookback commits containing the area of n_c - r*d_c); exact rational, no rounding
policy.ratio: r = n_anchor/d_anchor (reduced) when n_anchor > 0 and d_anchor > 0, else 0

selection.method: universe = endpoint inventory plus every area present at any first-parent commit of the evaluation window (existence only, no counts); coverage anchor = earliest first-parent ancestor whose tree contains every endpoint area; it calibrates every area it contains; any other universe area is calibrated at the latest first-parent commit at or before the coverage anchor containing it; each anchor's lookback = the contiguous first-parent run ending at it with committer ts in [anchor_ts - days*86400, anchor_ts]
selection.revision: spec/2 adds per-area anchors for window areas absent at the coverage anchor; spec/1 (coverage anchor only, digest 17119abad7c5458bcc71f3bdd81d7c8ae1d290350e3264b0d0c7fcad2bcd25db) left Solidity/Scratch on the fallback; the revision was made after replaying spec/1
